text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Surely, that day was where it all began.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That very first step I took, chasing after 
my sister when she invited me to race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That single step decided my way of life. 
And even now, I am taking yet another new 
step forward.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
So that I may continue to run [live] 
forever.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Brian! Brian! Brian! Brian!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How was it, Brian? The Twinkle Series, I 
mean.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's just like Sis said before.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
A place where each and every one aims 
high, striving to reach the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It was a place where the strong gathered.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You aren't satisfied yet either, are you? 
You're still aiming higher, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey hey hey hey!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya wants to join in there too! Next time 
I'm gonna go zoom right past you!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha, is that so. You'll chase after them 
too, then. Ah, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"You've come to show the way to others 
now, just like this, haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My little sister, who was so small and 
always chasing after me, has already grown 
up this much.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, let us all compete for the summit 
once more. And at the peak—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I will take the stage.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that selfishness of yours never 
changes, does it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So here is where you were, President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu, so I've been found out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the trouble, dumping work on you 
so suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, it is not a problem. So, how was 
Narita Brian?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You're right. To put it simply, they had 
gotten stronger.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Just watching her run makes my heart race. 
It's a stride that awakens the primal 
instinct of a racer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For you to say that much... It must have 
been quite a remarkable run.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. If you saw it, you'd surely think 
the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
He wished, somehow, to compete against her 
on that stage.

And so, the year-end Grand Prix, the Arima 
Kinen, drew to a close. Looking forward to 
the future with hope—
